anywhere                                                                           review
  ?                     this screen, except while a message is half typed            j / k                 move
  ctrl+c                quit, asked twice in a conversation                          enter                 open the changes, then a file
                                                                                     tab                   cycle the queue, ranking, cost outcome and overlap
chat                                                                                 c                     commit, from the file list
  enter                 send                                                         o                     a reviewer's opinion, from the ranking
  shift+tab             plan or build, which is what the agent may change            K                     credentials
  /                     the command list, which narrows as you type                  esc                   back one level
  up / down             move the command list, or otherwise your sent history
  tab                   take the highlighted command                               a diff
  //                    send a literal prompt beginning with slash                   j / k                 scroll a line
  esc                   interrupt the turn, or clear a half written message          space                 scroll a page
  ctrl+c                stop the turn, then twice to quit                            g / G                 top and end
  ctrl+n                a new conversation, keeping this one                         esc                   back to the file list
  ctrl+d                agents, and it works with a question waiting here
  ctrl+k                credentials                                                writing a commit
  ctrl+r                search what you have sent; ctrl+r again for older            ctrl+s                commit. nothing is staged until then
  /compact              summarise the conversation; typed twice, since it spends     esc                   cancel, throwing the message away
  ctrl+o                show tool output and diffs in full, and fold them back
  pgup / pgdown         scroll the conversation, or the btw panel while it is up   worktrees
  mouse drag            select conversation text, copied when you let go             j / k                 move
  ctrl+home / ctrl+end  the top, and back to following                               g / G                 top and end, as do home and end
  alt+enter             a line break instead of sending                              r                     refresh
  !command              run it here; its output goes with your next message          K                     credentials
  alt+k                 delete to the end of the line; ctrl+u to its start           esc / tab / q         agents
  ctrl+f                find in the conversation; enter older, down newer
  ctrl+y                copy the last code block, or the last reply                the model picker, on /model
  ctrl+p                every command, agent, conversation and file, as you type     j / k                 move, across credentials as well as within one
  @                     a file in this project, which narrows as you type            enter                 run this conversation on it from the next message
  ctrl+x ctrl+e         write the message in your editor                             ctrl+k                credentials, to change what a key defaults to
  # note                keep a note in AGENTS.md for later conversations             any other key         back, with nothing changed
  enter, box empty      try a failed turn again, where that can work
  enter / y             allow a tool call once, while a question is up             credentials
  a                     allow it for the rest of the session                         j / k                 move
  arrows / pgup         read on with a question up, deciding nothing                 enter                 use this one for the conversation
  any other key         refuse it                                                    m                     set which model it talks to
                                                                                     e                     rename it. the value is not asked for again
another agent's question, above the box                                              a / n                 add one
  enter                 approve it once, while the box is empty                      d / x                 remove one
  backspace             decline it, while the box is empty                           r                     reload the list
  ctrl+g                open its conversation and full request                       esc / tab             back to where you were
  a                     always is answered on that full prompt only                  q                     quit
